proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.touching_ground_with_item
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing activation/equipment gate vocabulary can express holding the item, but not the stricter requirement that the held item be touching the ground during activation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "While touching this 5-pound stone to the ground, you can take a Magic action to summon an Earth Elemental."

proposed_widenings.name: CreatureControl.unspecified_command_range_and_default_behavior
proposed_widenings.justification: The spawned-creature control surface currently requires a command range and fallback behavior even when the item text only says the creature obeys commands and gives no command radius or unstated-behavior rule.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "The elemental appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 30 feet of yourself, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count."

notes: Authored as magic_item + spawned_creature with catalog_ref(Earth Elemental), 1 use refreshed at dawn, 1-hour duration, and bonus-action dismissal. Placeholder values were required for control.commandRangeFeet and control.defaultBehavior. The tracer also omits turn-order and manual-dismiss details even though the JSON carries them.
